laws.name: Connecticut Family and Medical Leave Act (CTFMLA)
laws.description: Provides job-protected unpaid leave for eligible employees for medical leave, family caregiving, bonding, and certain military-related reasons.

laws.name: Connecticut Paid Family and Medical Leave (CT PFML)
laws.description: Provides paid wage replacement benefits for medical leave, family caregiving, bonding, and certain military-related reasons. Funded through employee payroll contributions.

laws.name: Connecticut School Parental Leave (K–12 Conferences)
laws.description: Allows employees to take time off to attend school-related conferences or classroom activities for their children.

laws.name: Connecticut Domestic Violence Leave
laws.description: Provides job-protected leave for victims of domestic violence to seek medical care, counseling, legal assistance, or relocate for safety.
